g.title: C4_Containers
g.text: onelastleaf (oll) - C4 Container Diagram - Current Implementation

g.title: bounded_client
g.text: Same Rust executable; parses one command, performs
local/bootstrap work or one Admin call, renders, and exits

g.title: node_daemon
g.text: Same Rust executable with Tokio; owns lifecycle,
Admin UDS, one node, and exactly one replica

g.title: user->deployment_files
g.text: Owns and may edit configuration and identity

g.title: bounded_client->node_daemon
g.text: Starts detached daemon and verifies readiness

g.title: bounded_client->deployment_files
g.text: Initializes deployment or locates Admin socket

g.title: node_daemon->deployment_files
g.text: Locks deployment; loads identity and configuration

g.title: node_daemon->working_tree
g.text: Watches/reconciles edits and projects replica state

g.title: replica_store
g.text: SQLite or PostgreSQL; durable catalog/document CRDTs,
blobs, operation history, and recovery state

g.title: node_daemon->replica_store
g.text: Persists and recovers authoritative replica state

g.title: log_files
g.text: oll.log and sync.log as user-owned JSON Lines

g.title: node_daemon->snapshot_archive
g.text: Exports or imports complete replica checkpoints
